d:
On this episode of WTA Style Unpacked, we catch up with tennis star Desirae Krawczyk to talk tennis, personal style and the looks that make a statement on and off the court!
Discover how athletic performance meets individual expression, get a glimpse into Desirae’s style personality, and celebrate the outfits that bring a little extra pop to the game.
From court-side confidence to standout fashion moments, this episode is all about showcasing the personality behind the player and the style that makes her shine.
